about: The Garza (SETTING.md §4): a caravela redonda of about 22 m, built at La Bocana forty years ago (Bartolo knew her on the stocks). Square-rigged fore and main, a lateen mizzen; a modest forecastle, a quarterdeck and a poop over a flat transom; carvel planking, two wales, a tallowed bottom. Her deck plan is data/locations/garza.json; this says how her outside looks. tools/ship/build_ship.py builds game/Assets/Ship/garza.glb from both.
